questionEn: Which statement about “mineral deposit” is correct?
questionUz: “Foydali qazilma koni” haqidagi qaysi fikr to‘g‘ri?
choicesEn: one or more mineral deposits, the extraction of which is profitable under certain economic conditions.
one or more mineral deposits, the extraction of which is profitable under certain conditions.
Natural mineral formations used by humans
choicesUz: ma'lum iqtisodiy sharoitlarda qazib olish foydali bo'lgan bir yoki bir nechta foydali qazilma konlari.
ma'lum sharoitlarda qazib olish foydali bo'lgan bir yoki bir nechta foydali qazilma konlari.

explanationEn: Mineral deposit - one or more mineral deposits, the extraction of which is profitable under certain economic conditions.
explanationUz: Foydali qazilma koni - ma'lum iqtisodiy sharoitlarda qazib olish foydali bo'lgan bir yoki bir nechta foydali qazilma konlari.
